structural_review.proof: Existing exact polynomial division gives quotients and remainder; a nonzero constant remainder is accepted only after exact reconstruction p=sum(q_i*d_i)+c. No SAT or Known(true) inference.
structural_review.fallback: Unproved cases retain the original coefficient plan and full CAD. Malformed source/family/observations still fail the original validation guards.
structural_review.legacy_reference: The full CAD path and checker remain; xy=1 with x=0 now has a verified root false leaf, while its complete three-cell geometric reference is retained in the test.
